info.title: Multibank CREST + MBIO API
info.description:
Dual-product client contract.

- **Brokerage (CREST / MEX):** `/api/v1/...` via Heimdall + IAM + crest-refdata + notifications; plus mobile-static hosts for content/geoip/countries/calendar/banners and localization.{domain}.
- **Exchange (MBIO):** `/api/io/v1/...` (and `/api/io/v2/...` widgets). Funding uses **portfolio** (not legacy wallet).

### Contract extensions
- `x-mb-product`: `brokerage` | `exchange` | `shared` | `mobile-static`
- `x-mb-status`: `implemented` | `planned` | `wip`

### Brokerage headers
- `x-broker-id`: MT5 trading account token/login (e.g. `1234ABCD`)
- `x-broker-type`: `demo` | `real` | `introducingBroker` (selected MT5 account type)
Required on brokerage trade calls; sent on all authenticated brokerage app requests.
